column1: # Cases for nudge-transcript-parsers.sh — one per line: <verdict><TAB><tool><TAB><command or file content>
# verdict is `pass` (no output) or `nudge` (additionalContext, never a permission decision). tool is Bash or
# Write; for Write the last column is the file's content. Use \n for a newline; the runner decodes it with printf %b.
# Each case runs in a session of its own, so the once-per-session rule is checked separately by the runner.
# Bash: a hand-written parser over the transcripts

column3:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, glob
for f in glob.glob("/home/u/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl"):
    json.loads(open(f).readline())
EOF
